what: Reference captures for Track A Weibo posts (DESIGN.md §7: a reference capture next to the discovery-source fingerprint). Weibo's indexed titles are generated summaries, not the post's words, so the title fingerprint undercounts served Weibo reads; these short quotes of each post's own opening words are a second fingerprint. A read is served by capture when >= 60% of the capture's grams occur in its text (bench/score.py, same normalisation).
audited_by: Track A bench builder, 2026-11-21, by reading the m.weibo.cn renderings of each post (author line, date and body) obtained during the run and checking them against the search-result title's topic.
